name: SEC v. Jarkesy
summary: The Supreme Court held that when the SEC seeks civil penalties for securities fraud, the Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial requires those claims to be brought in federal court, not decided by agency administrative law judges.
significance: This recent ruling that the SEC could not use in-house tribunals to adjudicate certain fraud penalties is the most directly on-point precedent and provides the analytical framework the Court will likely apply to the H-2A enforcement context.
